description: Use this when the person must be across a border by a time and asks when to get in line. through_by is a time in their words (16:00, 4 pm tomorrow). Not for the wait now: use get_border_wait. Answers the latest time to join the line to be through by the time given, at today's pace and the usual for those hours, with how sure it is; in the crossing's time zone.

crossing.description: a crossing's or airport's id as search_border_crossings shows it, or its name (Medyka, San Ysidro, Peace Bridge)

direction.description: the country the lane goes into: Poland, Ukraine, the United States

lane.description: cars (the default), trucks, coaches, walking, NEXUS, SENTRI, Ready Lane, FAST

through_by.description: a time in the person's words: 16:00, 4 pm tomorrow, Saturday 9:00

name: find_time_to_leave
title: Find the time to leave
